video_title: How to DEFEND the Philadelphia 76ers?! From LeBron James to Jaylen Brown, Embiid AND MORE...

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo's defensive strategy against the Philadelphia 76ers
quotes.excerpt: make them make a play, make them penetrate, make them pass the ball, let them unavailable
quotes.quote: I defend. For example, I put multiple positions. I get a lot of guys who switch. I just make them make a play, make them penetrate, make them pass the ball, let them unavailable whatever they have because they are going to have to connect. Imagine Tyrese Maxey is driving the ball, underneath is Joel Embiid, and he gets guarded, and then he just throws it up to LeBron James. Is LeBron James just going to catch and shoot it? Just think about it. He is going to just catch and shoot? No, he is not. He is going to just catch, he is going to make a play. He is a point guard, he is a point forward. This guy can make plays for everybody.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Why the Philadelphia 76ers signed Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.excerpt: That is why they signed KCP, they know they turn 3D players that glue.
quotes.quote: That is why they signed KCP, they know they turn 3D players that glue. It is not by chance that all these guys playing. I can talk from experience, not just as a watcher on TV. Who are the guys who have gotten paid the most and benefited the most with Giannis? With players like Giannis, players like LeBron and players like that, they penetrate, they get so much gravity and they pass out. Tony Snell, 40 plus million. Players who are not 3D guys, but they are a little bit taller, they shoot it well, they defend well, they are agile on the perimeter.

quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of the Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Spencer Dinwiddie trade on the Denver Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: I don't know if they can keep Peyton Watson now.

text_blocks.text: Did you know why that happened? Or did you people why or no?

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: I know they put them on an offer sheet and Denver matched it. But what did that do for Denver? Do you understand what is going to happen? I think it screwed them over. I don't know if they can keep Peyton Watson now.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: The return of Mario Hezonja to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Mario, Super Mario. He is back in the league.
quotes.quote: Mario, Super Mario. He is back in the league. Which is crazy. Nobody in Europe thought he was going to leave again. Europe is becoming so strong right now that everybody was coming back to Europe. It is becoming so strong everybody was like, and then he went back. It is okay.
